data.summary_en: ReSight separates keyframe evidence from derived fields; Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) finds capability gaps and converts solutions into memory builders, query tools, and skills. Fixed model/budget: EDM cuts OC-NaVQA average position error from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and raises FindingDory high-level success from 38.3% to 63.8%.
